nodes.text: @TimesAlgebraIND Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases are on the rise, particularly affecting children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. No vaccine or specific treatment yet. Stay vigilant: wash hands, clean surfaces, and avoid close contact if sick. #HMPvirus

nodes.author: SoniSoniSoni8
nodes.text:
@TimesAlgebraIND 1) HMPV is not a new virus, no need to panic.

2) It was first identified in 2001 and it has been circulating in the entire world since many years. 

3) HMPV is a common respiratory virus that typically causes mild cold-like symptoms.

4) The virus spreads more during the winter.
